query: 每个员工的订单总金额占全体员工订单总额的百分比

verdict.failure_reason: result_mismatch: 列名不一致: got=['emp_name', 'order_amount_percent'], golden=['emp_name', 'pct']

outcome.sql: WITH "emp_order_total" AS (SELECT "e"."emp_id" AS "emp_id", "e"."emp_name" AS "emp_name", COALESCE(SUM("o"."amount"), 0) AS "order_total_amount" FROM "public"."emp" "e" LEFT JOIN "public"."orders" "o" ON "e"."emp_id" = "o"."emp_id" GROUP BY "e"."emp_id", "e"."emp_name"), "grand_total" AS (SELECT SUM("order_total_amount") AS "total_amount" FROM "emp_order_total") SELECT "eot"."emp_name" AS "emp_name", ROUND(("eot"."order_total_amount" / NULLIF("gt"."total_amount", 0) * 100), 2)::text || '%' AS "order_amount_percent" FROM "emp_order_total" "eot" CROSS JOIN "grand_total" "gt" ORDER BY ("eot"."order_total_amount" / NULLIF("gt"."total_amount", 0)) DESC, "eot"."emp_name" ASC LIMIT 40
